name: Circle of the Moon (Druid Subclass - 2024)
description: Druids of the Circle of the Moon are masters of Wild Shape, using it to take on more powerful combat forms.
source: RPGBOT 2024 Circle of the Moon Druid Subclass Guide (PHB)
circle_spells_note: Circle of the Moon Spells are always prepared and do not count against the number of spells you can prepare each day.

3.name: Circle Forms
3.description: Your Wild Shape is enhanced: can use higher CR beasts (see Druid class Wild Shape progression). While in Wild Shape, your AC is 13 + Wisdom modifier. You gain temporary HP equal to three times your Druid level when you use this Wild Shape.

3.name: Circle of the Moon Spells
3.description: You always have certain spells prepared: Cantrip (Starry Wisp), L1 (Cure Wounds, Healing Word), L2 (Moonbeam - gained at Druid L3), L3 (Conjure Animals - gained at Druid L5), L4 (Polymorph - gained at Druid L7), L5 (Mass Cure Wounds - gained at Druid L9).

6.name: Improve Circle Forms
6.description: Lunar Radiance: Your attacks in beast form count as magical. Increased Toughness: Advantage on Constitution saving throws while in Wild Shape.

10.name: Moonlight Step
10.description: As a bonus action, teleport up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Usable Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest. Can expend a 2nd level or higher spell slot to use again.

14.name: Lunar Form
14.description: Improved Lunar Radiance: Once on each of your turns when you hit with an attack in beast form, deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage. Shared Moonlight: When you use Moonlight Step, you can choose one willing creature within 5 feet to teleport with you to a space adjacent to your destination.
